review_note: Human-reviewed rule set. This file, not the LLM draft, is what every downstream task reads. Codes were checked against the Synthea v4.0.0 modules and a generated sample.

egfr.note: eGFR as reported by Synthea (MDRD LOINC). Used for I3 because it tracks the simulated CKD stage; Synthea's creatinine does not.

egfr_ckdepi.note: Sensitivity only: CKD-EPI 2021 recomputed from the latest creatinine. Synthea creatinine is near 2.0 mg/dL at every CKD stage, so this is not used for eligibility.

prescreen.text: Indication-level screen a site would apply before referral: active chronic kidney disease diagnosis and adult age.

criteria.text: Provision of signed informed consent prior to any study specific procedures
criteria.reason: Procedural; not observable in EHR data.

criteria.text: Female or male aged ≥18 years at the time of consent
criteria.reason: Also part of the prescreen, so it removes nobody from the prescreened pool.

criteria.text: eGFR ≥25 and ≤75 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD-EPI Formula) at visit 1
criteria.reason: Partial: latest Synthea-reported eGFR within 365 days. The protocol asks for CKD-EPI; Synthea reports MDRD and its creatinine is not coherent enough to recompute CKD-EPI.
Latest UACR within 365 days. Synthea only measures UACR in type 2 diabetes and caps it near 600 mg/g, so the upper bound never binds.

criteria.text: Evidence of increased albuminuria 3 months or more before visit 1
criteria.reason: Any UACR ≥30 mg/g measured at least 90 days before the index date.

criteria.text: Stable, and for the patient maximum tolerated labelled daily dose, treatment with ACE-I or ARB for at least 4 weeks before visit 1, if not medically contraindicated
criteria.reason: Partial: duration of current ACE-I/ARB therapy is computable; 'maximum tolerated dose' and 'medically contraindicated' are not.

criteria.text: Autosomal dominant or autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease, lupus nephritis or ANCA-associated vasculitis
criteria.reason: Partial: Synthea models lupus erythematosus (used as a stand-in for lupus nephritis) but not PKD or ANCA vasculitis.

criteria.text: Receiving cytotoxic therapy, immunosuppressive therapy or other immunotherapy for primary or secondary renal disease within 6 months prior to enrolment
criteria.reason: Partial: drug class matched by name; the renal indication is not checked.

criteria.text: Receiving therapy with an SGLT2 inhibitor within 8 weeks prior to enrolment or previous intolerance of an SGLT2 inhibitor
criteria.reason: Partial: SGLT2 exposure is computable; intolerance is not recorded.
Computable, but Synthea does not model type 1 diabetes, so it removes nobody.

criteria.text: New York Heart Association (NYHA) class IV Congestive Heart Failure at the time of enrolment
criteria.reason: Latest NYHA functional class (LOINC 88020-3) within 365 days.

criteria.short: MI, UA, stroke or TIA ≤12 weeks
criteria.text: MI, unstable angina, stroke or transient ischemic attack within 12 weeks prior to enrolment
criteria.reason: Onset of MI, unstable angina or stroke; Synthea does not model TIA.
